description: WP-M4c Codex: Space Marines (11e) THUNDERHAWK INSERTION (Marneus Calgar) and CEREBREX LOGIC ENGINE (Caanok Var) in the Declare Battle Formations step. Fixture sm11e_m4c_formations (Formations, P1 Space Marines declare): the Formations dialog shows a 'CODEX: SPACE MARINES — BATTLE FORMATIONS ABILITIES' section with one picker + Apply per ability. Thunderhawk Insertion: the Intercessor Squad is picked and a real click on Apply gives it Deep Strike (the rebuilt form offers it Deep Strike reserves); Cerebrex Logic Engine: the Hellblaster Squad is picked and Apply gives it Scouts 6". Each choice is made once — the section is gone after both.

steps.comment: the Codex: Space Marines section is shown

steps.script: tree.root.get_node("Main/FormationsDialog").find_child("SM11EGrantApply_U_MARNEUS_CALGAR_A_thunderhawk_insertion", true, false) != null and tree.root.get_node("Main/FormationsDialog").find_child("SM11EGrantApply_U_CAANOK_VAR_A_cerebrex_logic_engine", true, false) != null
steps.comment: one row per ability (Calgar, Caanok Var)
pick the Intercessor Squad in the Thunderhawk Insertion picker (TACTICUS: eligible)
GRAVIS/PHOBOS/TACTICUS units only (Caanok Var is a TERMINATOR)
real click: Apply on the first row (Thunderhawk Insertion)
Thunderhawk Insertion: the Intercessors have Deep Strike
the rebuilt form no longer offers Thunderhawk Insertion (once)
pick the Hellblaster Squad in the Cerebrex Logic Engine picker
Cerebrex Logic Engine: the Hellblasters have Scouts 6"
nothing left to choose: the section is gone after the rebuild

steps.script: ScenarioRunner.event_log_count_containing("Thunderhawk Insertion (Marneus Calgar): Intercessor Squad has Deep Strike")
ScenarioRunner.event_log_count_containing("Cerebrex Logic Engine (Caanok Var): Hellblaster Squad has Scouts 6")

steps.comment: clean debug log: no ERROR line was written during the scenario
